summary: Cloudflare for Startups gives early-stage companies up to $350K in credits for one year across three tiers — $10K (bootstrapped/self-funded, <$1M raised), $100K (<$5M raised, affiliated-partner funded), $350K ($5M+ raised, affiliated-partner funded). Credits cover usage-based services: Workers, Durable Objects, Workflows, Workers AI (capped $2.5K/$10K/$50K by tier), R2 (capped $10K), Pages, Images, Stream; core security/networking features are included at no cost. AI Gateway is temporarily not covered.
claim_steps: Confirm eligibility: founded within 10 years, funded up to Series B within the last 12 months, building a technology product, public website, active on LinkedIn/X/GitHub, first-time applicant, business email matching your domain.
Credits are valid for one year or until fully consumed, whichever comes first.
